Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You call the moment, and your companions answer with a single rush of steel.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Two allies within 4 squares who hear you and are adjacent to enemies.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
Each attacking ally needs its own melee weapon. This card grants no equipment.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Utility

Each makes one free Basic Melee attack. After its attack, each may move 1 square without provoking. These attacks never trigger additional free attacks.

Each granted Basic Melee attack uses its attacker’s Brawn and Basic Melee outcomes; this card adds no separate roll beyond any roll it explicitly requires.
